title: Email: Fw: Great story on Tiger's rebuilding!

content.subject: Fw: Great story on Tiger's rebuilding!

content.text:
From: Dennis Lakomy <dennislakomy@gmail.com>
Sent: Wednesday, October 17, 2018 2:22 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Great story on Tiger's rebuilding! 
 
Hi Anthony,

That was a great story on the Tiger’s rebuilding in the Detroit Free Press on Sunday, October 14.  Thank you for the mention of Don Kelly, one of my favorite Tigers.  How about a longer story about Don Kelly and some of the other “unknown” staff?  Dennis Lakomy
